description.it: Installa gitsigns.nvim con configurazione base e mappature per navigare gli hunk.
description.en: Install gitsigns.nvim with basic configuration and hunk navigation mappings.

exercises.solution:
return {
  'lewis6991/gitsigns.nvim',
  event = 'VeryLazy',
  config = function()
    local gitsigns = require('gitsigns')
    gitsigns.setup()
    vim.keymap.set('n', ']h', gitsigns.next_hunk)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '[h', gitsigns.prev_hunk)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hp', gitsigns.preview_hunk)
  end,
}

description.it: Aggiungi keymap per stage, reset e undo stage di singoli hunk.
description.en: Add keymaps for stage, reset, and undo stage of individual hunks.

exercises.solution:
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hs', gitsigns.stage_hunk, { desc = '[H]unk [S]tage' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hr', gitsigns.reset_hunk, { desc = '[H]unk [R]eset' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hu', gitsigns.undo_stage_hunk, { desc = '[H]unk [U]ndo stage' })

description.it: Configura keymap per tutti i picker Git di Telescope.
description.en: Configure keymaps for all Telescope Git pickers.

hints: Tutti i picker sono in telescope.builtin
exercises.solution:
local builtin = require('telescope.builtin')
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>gf', builtin.git_files, { desc = '[G]it [F]iles' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>gs', builtin.git_status, { desc = '[G]it [S]tatus' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>gc', builtin.git_commits, { desc = '[G]it [C]ommits' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>gb', builtin.git_branches, { desc = '[G]it [B]ranches' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>gS', builtin.git_stash, { desc = '[G]it [S]tash' })

description.it: Crea un comando personalizzato per mostrare un preview flottante dell'hunk.
description.en: Create a custom command to show a floating preview of the hunk.

exercises.solution:
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hp', function()
  gitsigns.preview_hunk_inline()
end, { desc = '[H]unk [P]review inline' })

-- Float preview con gitsigns
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>hP', function()
  gitsigns.preview_hunk()
end, { desc = '[H]unk [P]review float' })
